title: Understanding Quartiles
text: A box plot visually represents the distribution of data. The box itself shows the interquartile range (IQR), which contains the middle 50% of the data. The line inside the box represents the median, or the second quartile (Q2).

title: Identifying Quartiles in a Box Plot
text: In a box plot, the edges of the box represent the first quartile (Q1) and the third quartile (Q3). The whiskers extend to the smallest and largest values within $$1.5$$ times the IQR from the quartiles.
